newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded again, ends disappointing week.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded again, ends disappointing week.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures remained untraded for the second consecutive session on Friday. The contract did not trade at all on either Thursday or Friday.
By the close, bids were posted for all 12 monthly contracts although bids were only seen for July, the front month, August and October.
Bid offer ranges were reasonably tight in each case, respectively 10.00/10.25 pence a therm, 10.00/10.40 pence a therm and 12.10/12.30 pence a therm.
The contract has had a disappointing week, with only 70 lots traded over the whole time.
